## Source code of MPL-2.0 and GPL components

- Eigen: https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen (release 5.0.1).
- eSpeak NG: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng (commit 688cb60368d6e0998f3632af8d1c3c2ad4191fc2, version 1.53.0); this application is itself published with its source.
- sherpa-onnx: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx (release v2.0.1); ONNX Runtime binaries: https://github.com/csukuangfj/onnxruntime-libs (release v1.28.2).

## Voices

English: "ljspeech-medium", a Piper voice trained from scratch on the LJ Speech dataset (public domain,
https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/). Voice file: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices (model card: voice-ljspeech-medium-MODEL_CARD.txt).

Italian: "riccardo-it-xlow", a Piper voice trained from scratch on the M-AILABS Italian speech dataset
(audio from LibriVox, public domain). Dataset licence, Copyright (c) 2017-2019 by the original creators @ M-AILABS
and (c) 2020 I. Celeste Aurora Solak (github.com/i-celeste-aurora):
redistribution and use in any form, including commercial use, are permitted provided that the copyright notice,
the conditions and the disclaimer are retained, and the names of the copyright holders are not used to endorse
derived products. Full text: voice-riccardo-M-AILABS-licence.txt. Model card: voice-riccardo-MODEL_CARD.txt.

The Apache-2.0 text of sherpa-onnx, kaldi-native-fbank, kaldi-decoder and eSpeak NG is the same text and is kept once, in sherpa-onnx-Apache-2.0.txt.

## Bundled assets of the project

- Digit font DSEG7 Classic by keshikan, SIL Open Font License 1.1: `app/fonts/DSEG-LICENSE.txt`, installed with the app in the folder `fonts`.
- Sounds: original, synthesised by `tools/make-sounds.py`, CC0 1.0 (`data/sounds/README.md`).
- Exercise pictograms: generated by `tools/make-exercise-icons.py`, original, CC0 1.0 (`data/exercise-icons/README.md`).
- Workout icons: provided by the project author, CC0 1.0 (`data/workout-icons/README.md`).
- Pictures of the first page: drawn by the project author, CC0 1.0 (`data/mode-icons/README.md`).
- Pictures of the muscle groups: CC0 1.0 (`data/muscle-groups/README.md`).
- Starter data: the structure of the starter library, its texts and its workouts (`data/starter/`) are CC0 1.0 (`data/starter/README.md`).
- Application icon and its monochrome silhouette for the cover: drawn by the project author, CC0 1.0 (`data/app-icon/README.md`).
